# Metering

One run's usage report: how many model calls it made, the input, output and cached input tokens the provider reported for them and their cost in millionths of a US dollar at the run's rate card, in total and for each executor call of the run. A cost no rate card priced is absent, never zero.

`loom.metering` is one of loom's bounded contexts. [All domains](./index.mdx).

## Types

### `RunUsageReport`

`loom.metering.RunUsageReport` is a record of seven fields:

- `commission_run` — `loom.run.CommissionRunId`
- `model_calls` — `Integer`
- `input_tokens` — `Integer`
- `output_tokens` — `Integer`
- `cached_input_tokens` — `Integer`
- `cost_micro_usd` — `Optional<Integer>`, which may be absent
- `steps` — `List<loom.metering.StepUsage>`

### `StepUsage`

`loom.metering.StepUsage` is a record of six fields:

- `step` — `Integer`
- `model_calls` — `Integer`
- `input_tokens` — `Integer`
- `output_tokens` — `Integer`
- `cached_input_tokens` — `Integer`
- `cost_micro_usd` — `Optional<Integer>`, which may be absent

One of the types above is reached by nothing else in this system: `loom.metering.RunUsageReport`. No entity, view, command, event, error or crossing names it, so it is either vocabulary something outside this specification uses or a leftover — and only a person can tell which.
